response.description: A controlled NextItNet sequential recommendation experiment across four Amazon datasets: Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Preserve the supplied corrected NextItNet backbone and train one independent model per category. Select changes using macro-average validation HR@10.
response.motivation: Measure improvements within the NextItNet family under fixed data splits, seeds, evaluation conditions, and compute limits, without ensemble effects or test-set feedback.
response.implementation_notes: Use preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, at most 200 epochs, and 200 batches per epoch. Keep DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] and save artifacts beneath the trial directory. For left-padded histories, read the final nonpadding position, never count-1. Preserve category routing, the ModelView compatibility interfaces, and the required diagnosis APIs. Update the embedded predictor whenever architecture changes; each category must load exactly one trained checkpoint. Evaluate through the host's pinned validation procedure and respect the shared 43,200 GPU-second search budget. The supplied description contains no baseline source code or measured results, so implementation details and performance cannot be verified.
response.pseudocode:
set_preprocessing_seed(0)
for category in FOUR_CATEGORIES:
    set_training_seed(42)
    data = load_supplied_splits(os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], category)
    model = supplied_corrected_nextitnet(category)
    train(model, data.train, max_epochs=200, batches_per_epoch=200)
    save_one_checkpoint(model, trial_directory, category)
write_matching_predictor_with_category_routing()
# Host independently measures validation HR@10 per category.
# Selection objective: arithmetic mean of the four validation HR@10 values.
